test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The principal who had retired last year (1)/ and was honoured by all faculty members (2)/ were awarded a lifetime achievement certificate by the board (3)/ on the occasion of annual convocation. (4)

options.text: The principal who had retired last year (1)
and was honoured by all faculty members (2)
were awarded a lifetime achievement certificate by the board (3)
on the occasion of annual convocation (4)

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the verb form "**were**" in part (3). The subject of the sentence, "**The principal**," is singular and requires a singular verb.
 
• The correct verb should be "**was**" instead of "**were**."
 
• The revised sentence should be grammatically consistent with subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The principal who had retired last year and was honoured by all faculty members **was** awarded a lifetime achievement certificate by the board on the occasion of annual convocation."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The principal who had retired last year"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "and was honoured by all faculty members"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "on the occasion of annual convocation"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
